title: Priyanka Chopra Turns 44: Varanasi First Look Drops as Nick Jonas Celebrates in Spain
excerpt: The makers of SS Rajamouli's epic Varanasi unveiled Priyanka Chopra's fierce first look as Mandakini on her birthday, while Nick Jonas shared a romantic holiday video from Spain.
body:
• The makers of Varanasi, directed by SS Rajamouli, dropped Priyanka Chopra's first look as Mandakini on her 44th birthday — a fierce, warrior-like character in the epic action-adventure film.
  • Nick Jonas celebrated the occasion from Spain, posting a holiday video and calling Priyanka his "mi amor."
  • Varanasi is reportedly being made on a budget of approximately ₹1,400 crore, starring Mahesh Babu in the lead role alongside Priyanka and Prithviraj Sukumaran.
  • Priyanka was recently nominated for a Critics Choice Super Award for her role in The Bluff, capping a strong awards season.

Mandakini Arrives

Priyanka Chopra Jonas turned 44 on Friday, and the team behind Varanasi — the globe-trotting epic directed by SS Rajamouli — chose the occasion to drop her first look as Mandakini. The reveal immediately set social media on fire.

In the first images, Priyanka appears in a striking warrior-like avatar against a dark, dramatic backdrop. She wears a bralette-style outfit with mesh detailing and a corset fit, her hair deliberately tousled and her eyes done in heavy smoky makeup. A second image captures a starkly different mood: Mandakini leaping freely in an open field, carefree and exuberant. The contrast hints at the range the character will demand.

https://x.com/indiablooms/status/2078385960383820194

Sharing the photos, the film's official page wrote: "To more adventures… More discoveries and journeys across every horizon."

The Scale of Varanasi

Varanasi is shaping up to be one of Indian cinema's most ambitious productions. Produced by Sri Durga Arts, the 2027 film is reportedly being made on a budget of approximately ₹1,400 crore — putting it among the most expensive Indian films ever produced. Mahesh Babu plays the lead role of Rudhra, with Priyanka as his ally Mandakini and Prithviraj Sukumaran as the antagonist Kumbha.

For Priyanka, the film marks her return to Indian cinema after years focused on Hollywood projects. Her recent work includes The Bluff, for which she received a Critics Choice Super Award nomination, and the spy thriller series Citadel on Amazon Prime Video, which ran from 2023 to 2026.

Birthday in Spain

While the Varanasi team handled the professional celebrations, Nick Jonas took care of the personal ones. The singer shared a video from the couple's holiday in Spain, calling Priyanka his "mi amor" and posting romantic moments from their vacation. The couple, who married in 2018 and share daughter Malti Marie, have made birthday celebrations a tradition — last year's featured a beachside holiday with similar social media fanfare.

Bollywood and Hollywood colleagues flooded social media with birthday wishes throughout the day. Priyanka's journey from Miss World 2000 to becoming one of the most recognizable Indian faces in global entertainment has made her birthday a calendar event for the Indian diaspora worldwide.

A Global Career in Full Stride

At 44, Priyanka Chopra continues to straddle Bollywood and Hollywood in a way few Indian actors have managed. Her upcoming slate includes Varanasi, which pairs her with Rajamouli — the director behind the Baahubali franchise and RRR — and places her at the center of a production designed for global audiences.

Her production company, Purple Pebble Pictures, continues to develop content across languages, and she remains one of the most-followed Indians on social media globally. The Varanasi first look suggests she's leaning into roles with physical intensity and dramatic range — a departure from the more contained performances of her recent Hollywood work.
